title: Weekly Review
description: Summarize project work, real costs, wins and open loops for the week.

assignments.task: Use the bounded project activity record to summarize completed work, actual costs, wins and unresolved runs, clearly distinguishing reported outcomes from verified delivery.

fields.label: Sources, evidence and owner instructions
fields.help: {focus?}; the activity tool derives project scope from the claimed run.
fields.default: Focus on completed work, costs and open loops.

instructions: Use the deterministic project.activity input for the last seven days. Cite mission/run IDs, show actual model cost and open-loop counts, and explain any truncated list. Do not inspect another project or infer that a completed agent response proves an external delivery. Return a concise weekly review and prioritized owner decisions for Calm Mode.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Enable Chief of Staff and grant project.activity if the existing agent predates this tool.
approvalPoints: Read-only report; notifications use Calm Mode.
limitations: The activity list is bounded to the 50 most recent runs; costs and open-loop counts cover the full selected interval within this project.
eventContract: {focus?}; the activity tool derives project scope from the claimed run.
